spans.s: Revata, (= Pali id.) n. of a disciple of Buddha (only in lists of names): SP 〔2.4〕; 〔207.4〕; LV 〔1.17〕; Av 〔i.213.10〕; 〔ii.112.4〕; 〔135.1〕; Gv 〔17.22〕; Sukh 〔2.9〕; 〔92.7〕. See also Raivata.
Revataka, n. of a stream (raya; Burnouf Intr. 〔396 with note 2〕 evidently read ratha, as he renders char, but context makes this hardly possible): Divy 〔399.12〕.
Revatī, n. of a yakṣiṇī (= Skt. id.? see BR s.v. Revant, 2e): Mmk 〔564.25〕; 〔566.1〕. Cf. next (?).

revatī-graha, n. of a class of demons (follows rākṣasa; followed by śakuni-graha, which occurs in Skt., see BR): Mvy 〔4765〕 = Tib. nam gruḥi gdon, demon of (the constellation) Revatī. Perhaps to be connected with prec.
